sections.description: Qalour Lite is a Painting and Wall Finishing Services WordPress Block Theme designed for businesses that want to create a modern and professional home improvement website. Built with Full Site Editing and powered by Gutenberg, this theme provides a flexible and visually refined platform to showcase painting services, wall finishing solutions, and completed projects with a clean and polished design. Whether you run a painting company, wallpaper installation service, or home renovation business, Qalour Lite helps you present your services clearly and effectively. It is ideal for professional painters, wallpaper specialists, handymen, wall repair experts, and home improvement providers looking to strengthen their online presence. With responsive layouts, customizable block patterns, and well-structured pages, you can easily highlight service offerings, project galleries, customer testimonials, and contact information. Optimized for performance and ease of use, Qalour Lite enables you to build a professional website that reflects your craftsmanship, reliability, and expertise in painting and wall finishing services.
